leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Aethera Technologies is a Halifax radio-frequency engineering company developing solid-state RF power systems, custom electronics, software and engineering services for space propulsion, fusion energy, wireless communications and industrial processing. Aethera develops solid-state RF generators and power-processing electronics that can be adapted for high-power industrial processes and electric space-propulsion systems, including vacuum-qualified work associated with VASIMR. A Canadian Space Agency profile documents a $1.5 million contribution and successful testing of Aethera power-processing technology for Ad Astra's VASIMR system, while Aethera's current official site continues to present RF products and engineering activity from Halifax.

Magnestar's 24/7x software combines satellite-spectrum data, interference simulation models and coordination workflows to identify potential communication conflicts and support interference-free satellite operations. Magnestar's official site currently presents its 24/7x product, the federal corporate registry lists Magnestar Inc. as active, and CanadaBuys records a competitively awarded DND IDEaS military-science contract.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Ashored Innovations is a Nova Scotia ocean-technology company developing acoustic rope-on-command fishing gear, subsea buoy-containment hardware and gear-tracking software for safer, data-backed fixed-gear fisheries. Ashored's Rope-On-Command system keeps retrieval rope contained on the seabed until an acoustic command releases a buoy, while ATLAS software and tags support gear location, ownership and inventory tracking. Ashored's current official product and resource pages document ROC, MOBI and ATLAS offerings, while Government of Canada funding records and an Ocean Technology Council directory establish Nova Scotia operations and public commercialization support.

Marimetrics develops an in-situ analyzer intended to measure multiple chemical compounds simultaneously with high sensitivity and real-time output for water, air and vessel-exhaust monitoring. Marimetrics' official site continues to offer its real-time analyzer from Dartmouth, and Invest Nova Scotia currently lists the company among featured Start-Up Yard at COVE firms; an ACOA record documents commercialization support.

leads.candidateCapabilityName: Prosaris ultrasonic detection and management system
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Prosaris Solutions is a Nova Scotia industrial-sensing company developing handheld ultrasonic sensors and software for detecting, recording and managing compressed-air, gas, vacuum, electrical and mechanical anomalies. Prosaris pairs handheld ultrasonic sensing hardware with a mobile application and leak-management platform to locate acoustic anomalies, capture records and support resolution workflows for fluid, electrical and mechanical systems. An ACOA backgrounder documents a $500,000 contribution to expand Prosaris production and software, while current company material continues to describe the ultrasonic device and leak-management platform.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Guardian Mobility is an Ottawa aviation-connectivity company that designs satellite and cellular tracking, communications and flight-data systems for crewed aircraft, UAS, emergency response, law enforcement and government operations. The G6 is an all-in-one Iridium Certus 100 satellite terminal providing bidirectional IP data, voice, tracking, telemetry and application interfaces for aircraft and UAS operating beyond reliable terrestrial coverage. Iridium currently lists Guardian's G6-S for autonomous systems, and Flightcell documents selection of the G6 Certus 100 terminal for Bristow search-and-rescue helicopters, providing partner corroboration beyond Guardian's own product pages.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Edison Motors is a British Columbia vehicle manufacturer developing diesel-electric series-hybrid vocational trucks, powertrains, chassis and conversion systems for logging, hauling, plowing and other heavy-duty work. Edison's current official site reports 2026 environmental approval and operation of a new Golden-area factory, while an Open Government record documents a hybrid-electric snowplow pilot using the L500 platform.

leads.candidateCapabilityName: Digital seafood operations and sensor ecosystem
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Sedna Technologies is a Dartmouth ocean-technology company developing seafood traceability, dockside operations, inventory and sales software alongside water-quality and sensor systems for fisheries and aquaculture. Sedna combines inventory, sales, traceability, dockside settlement, quality-control and reporting software with water-quality and other sensor inputs to digitize seafood operations from harvest through sale. Sedna's current official site describes an operating seafood software and sensor ecosystem, while ACOA records both technology-development contributions and a customer digitization project using Sedna as the implementation vendor.
